scope: Seven persisted operating samples and public-interface roadmap review; no new CVE research or source admission
measurementScope: Collection requests, bytes and elapsed backend execution only. Reserved research minutes are capacity reservations, not billed compute. External reasoning, tokens and monetary charges are unavailable.

decision.rationale: Seven daily samples are available and collection stays below the cap, but the queue grew from 66 to 77 and 17 investigations remain pending. Improve intake quality and evidence usability before adding another source or portfolio cohort.

deliveryEvidence.ownerConfirmation: October 29 owner confirms public navigation, bespoke chrome and first-class interface status
deliveryEvidence.qualification: Navigation delivery does not certify comprehensive Cisco coverage or resolve every planned finding journey.

remainingWork.scope: Advisory identity normalization, separate vendor-under-investigation from parse/transport failure, and preserve all queue/history evidence.
